card.title: The sound that crossed an ocean

body.question: In 1883, the Krakatoa explosions were heard on an island near Mauritius. About how far away was that?
body.reveal: The explosions were so violent that they were heard 3,110 km away in Perth, Western Australia, and on the island of Rodrigues near Mauritius, 4,800 km away.

probes.question: True or false: the 1883 Krakatoa explosions were heard in Perth, Western Australia.
Which island near Mauritius heard the Krakatoa explosions?

image_brief.show: The 1883 Krakatoa eruption, or the volcano island today (Anak Krakatau)

claims.quote: The 1883 eruption ejected approximately 25 km (6 cubic miles) of rock.

claims.claim: Explosions heard 3,110 km away in Perth, Western Australia (reveal, probe 1)
claims.quote: heard 3,110 km (1,930 mi) away in Perth , Western Australia

claims.claim: Explosions heard on Rodrigues near Mauritius, 4,800 km away (question, answer, reveal, probe 2)
claims.quote: the island of Rodrigues near Mauritius , 4,800 km (3,000 mi) away
claims.note: The same page gives 4,780 km in its intro (Rodrigues near Mauritius, 4,780 km to the west). The page is internally inconsistent by 20 km; 'About 4,800 km' is correct under both, options 480 / 48,000 are clearly wrong, and the reveal's 4,800 is the page's own wording in the Eruption section.
